title: Media Inspection
description: Deterministic inspection of a binary artifact: detected format, dimensions, page count and whether visual inspection is required. Fields whose value cannot be measured are reported as null together with the source that produced them, so a consumer can always tell a measured value from a missing one.

media_type.description: MIME type detected from the payload container, not from the filename or the caller's declaration.

declared_media_type.description: MIME type the caller declared for this artifact. Retained so a caller can tell its declaration from the detected container type.

file_size_bytes.description: Total size of the artifact in bytes.

is_image.description: Whether the payload is a recognizable raster image.

is_pdf.description: Whether the payload is a PDF document.

page_count.description: Number of pages or frames; 1 for single-frame images and for artifacts whose page count could not be determined.

page_count_source.description: Mechanism that produced page_count; null when it could not be determined.

dimensions.description: Pixel dimensions of the primary image or first page; null when they could not be measured.

dimensions_source.description: Mechanism that measured dimensions; null when they are unknown.

color_mode.description: Color model reported by the image container (e.g. RGB, RGBA, L, CMYK); null when not applicable.

format.description: Container format name (e.g. JPEG, PNG, PDF, TIFF); null when unrecognized.

artifact_nature.description: Classification heuristic of the artifact nature.

document_genre.description: Whether a PDF is a slide deck (presentation) or another document; null when it was not measured (images, or PDFs without PyMuPDF). Absent in reports from providers older than pure-media-inspect 1.1.0.

genre_signals.description: Why document_genre is presentation: the producer or creator software (producer:PowerPoint) or the page geometry (geometry:landscape-uniform). Empty for a document.

requires_visual_inspection.description: Flag indicating that the artifact is, or contains, prominent visual content the agent must inspect with vision.
